18. Design pattern categories

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Creational patterns manage creation, structural patterns organize relationships or
interfaces, behavioral patterns organize interactions and algorithms.
සිංහJලෙන් Creational වල object හදන විදිහ, Structural වල objects සම්බන්ධ කරන විදිහ, Behavioral වල
objects අතර behavior සහ communication බලනවා.

Factory creates a payment client; Adapter wraps it; Strategy chooses which payment algorithm
to use.
Creational Factory, Builder · Structural Adapter, Facade · Behavioral Strategy, Observer · Read the diagram: Each card represents a separate design idea. · එක් card එකක් එක් අදහසක් Jපන්වනවා.
Expected result: The creation decision is separate from the checkout behavior.

Q: Which category is Observer?
A: Behavioral, because it coordinates notifications between objects.
